bottom.description: Inset from the bottom edge, px.

fps.description: Frame rate cap for the background canvas. 0 removes the cap.

effects.description: Stack of background effects rendered in order (bottom → top)

enabled.description: Set to false to disable this effect without removing it

transition.description: How long, in ms, an entity-bound config value (map_range or a template) glides to its new value. 0 snaps. Under reduced motion values always snap.

item_config.description: Preset-specific configuration options. Shape depends on the sibling `preset` field. Supports entity-reactive values via map_range descriptor ({ map_range: { entity, attribute, input, output } }) or template strings ([[[...]]]). entity (the older entity_id also works) defaults to the card-bound entity.

item_config_10.description: Params for the "cascade" preset: LCARS waterfall colour-cycling data grid. A single instance changes every matched cell in sync (mode: css's delay is one flat value); the row-by-row "waterfall" look (including the niagara timing pattern) requires declaring multiple separate instances, one per row; see lcards-data-grid's animation.pattern option, which automates that.

item_config_11.description: Params for the "level" preset: animated tank/gauge fill bar.

item_config_12.description: Params for the "fluid" preset: swirling single-colour noise wash.

item_config_13.description: Params for the "plasma" preset: two-colour plasma noise bands.

item_config_14.description: Params for the "flow" preset: directional streaming noise streaks.

item_config_15.description: Params for the "shimmer" preset: sweeping highlight band.

item_config_16.description: Params for the "scanlines" preset: static CRT-style scanline overlay.

item_config_17.description: Params for the "image" preset: user-supplied image rendered behind the full card area. Field is `source` (not `url`; a page of docs previously used `url` throughout, which never worked; fixed).

item_config_18.description: Params for the "solid" preset: flat single-colour fill, the cheapest background preset (no procedural noise).

item_config_19.description: Params for the "warp-starfield" preset: stars flying at the viewer in 3D (three.js, WebGL), stretching into streaks as speed rises above 1. Without WebGL the starfield preset is drawn with the same config.

item_config_20.description: Params for the "holo-sphere" preset: a rotating latitude/longitude wireframe planet with a scan band (three.js where WebGL is available, the same look on Canvas2D otherwise).

item_config_4.description: Params for the "grid" preset: orthogonal scrolling grid with optional major/minor divisions.

item_config_5.description: Params for the "grid-diagonal" preset: 45° hatched variant of grid. Pattern is hardcoded to diagonal, not user-overridable.

item_config_6.description: Params for the "grid-hexagonal" preset: honeycomb hex-grid variant of grid. Pattern is hardcoded to hexagonal, not user-overridable.

item_config_7.description: Params for the "starfield" preset: scrolling parallax star field.

item_config_8.description: Params for the "nebula" preset: layered Perlin-noise cloud blobs.

item_config_9.description: Params for the "contour-field" preset: topographic-style banded noise field. Defaults below are the REAL zero-config resolved values (verified against ContourFieldEffect.js/presets/index.js), not the sparser set previously shown in guide.params; the shipped default is a visible tinted fill with a 5-stop gradient, not transparent/single-color.

item_config_spectrum_2.description: Streaks split into colour along their length (the TNG warp look): a Doppler shift of each star's own colour, violet toward the tail (nearer the direction of travel) and red toward the head. White stars show the whole rainbow; a blue star streaks green to violet, its tail fading past violet. Fades in as the dots stretch; dots keep their colour.

item_config_surface_2.description: What the grid is drawn on. plane: the flat grid or floor (view). cylinder, dome (a half sphere), sphere and well (a funnel of any profile: well_shape, well_profile): a wireframe surface for astrometrics displays, spun by the scroll speed that runs round it. On a dome or sphere the diagonal and hexagonal patterns draw rows and columns. Tile seams (show_border_lines) belong to the plane. Drawn with WebGL; without it (or with renderer: canvas) the flat grid is drawn.

item_config_surface_axis_2.description: Which way a cylinder, dome or well points. vertical: an upright cylinder, a dome over the floor, a well opening upward. horizontal: a cylinder lying across the card (scroll_speed_y rolls it), a dome facing you with its pole in the middle (rings and spokes), a well opening toward you. The sphere always has its poles up; turn it with the camera. WebGL only.

item_config_surface_length_2.description: Length of a cylinder along its axis, or the depth of a well (rim to throat), as a fraction of the card's size that way (height when vertical, width when horizontal); 0 runs a cylinder off the card and into the distance (a well keeps at least 0.1). WebGL only. Animatable.

item_config_surface_rotate_x_2.description: Turns a curved surface itself about the card's horizontal axis, in degrees: positive tips its top toward you. With surface_rotate_y and surface_rotate_z (applied x, then y, then z) it can face any way, and the camera keys still orbit it. Not used on the plane (turn the camera instead). WebGL only. Animatable.

oneOf.description: Turns a curved surface itself about the card's vertical axis, in degrees: positive turns its front to the right. WebGL only. Animatable.

item_config_surface_side_2.description: Where the camera is. outside: it looks at the surface from camera_distance. inside: it sits at the centre (slid back by camera_distance above 1) and looks out: down a horizontal cylinder as a tunnel at camera_yaw 0, up into a dome as a planetarium with camera_tilt. A well is always seen from outside. WebGL only.

delay.description: How far into its cycle the row starts, seconds.

item_config_view_2.description: flat: the grid face-on. floor: a perspective floor streaming toward the viewer, fading to a horizon. Drawn with WebGL; without it (or with renderer: canvas) the flat grid is drawn.

item_config_well_profile_2.description: Any well shape: diameters as fractions of surface_size, from the rim down to the bottom, evenly spaced along the depth; a smooth curve passes through every one. [1, 0.4, 0.2, 0.15] is a trumpet, [1, 0.2, 1] an hourglass (a wormhole), [1, 0.9, 0.5, 0] a closed bowl. Replaces well_shape and well_throat. The rings are evenly spaced along the surface (line_spacing px apart), however steep it is. WebGL only.

oneOf.description: A second well profile (the same form as well_profile) to morph toward: well_morph blends from the well's shape (0) to this one (1). Animate well_morph to morph the funnel. WebGL only.
Template string ([[[ JavaScript ]]] or a {token}), evaluated on every Home Assistant update.

Ripples running down the well: their height as a fraction of the local radius (0 = none, 0.1 a gentle swell). The grid rings stay where they are and the waves pass through them. WebGL only. Animatable.
Template string ([[[ JavaScript ]]] or a {token}), evaluated on every Home Assistant update.
Ripple speed in waves per second: positive runs down toward the throat, negative up toward the rim, 0 holds them still. WebGL only. Animatable.

item_config_well_shape_2.description: Profile of a well from its rim down to its throat. trumpet: the gravity well, nearly flat at the rim and plunging to the throat. cone: straight sides. bowl: rounded toward the bottom. wormhole: two trumpets throat to throat (an hourglass, the throat halfway down). well_profile replaces it. WebGL only.

enumDescriptions.trumpet: Gravity well: flat rim, plunging throat
enumDescriptions.wormhole: Hourglass: two trumpets throat to throat

oneOf.description: Throat diameter of a well_shape, as a fraction of its rim (surface_size): small for a deep, narrow throat, 1 for a cylinder. Not used with well_profile. WebGL only. Animatable.
Template string ([[[ JavaScript ]]] or a {token}), evaluated on every Home Assistant update.

item_renderer.description: How a preset with a WebGL version is drawn (warp-starfield, grid, holo-sphere, the noise presets and the other three.js presets). auto: WebGL when the browser has it, otherwise the Canvas2D version. webgl: the same, stated explicitly; without WebGL it still draws the Canvas2D version, so the background never goes blank. canvas: always the Canvas2D version (no GPU use). Ignored by presets that are Canvas2D only.

enumDescriptions.webgl: Prefer WebGL (falls back to Canvas2D without it)

item_zoom.description: Optional zoom wrapper: creates layered depth effect

layers.description: Copies of the effect zooming at once, evenly staggered through the cycle.

scale_from.description: Scale a layer starts at (1 = the effect at its normal size).

scale_to.description: Scale a layer reaches before it fades out.

duration.description: Seconds for one layer to zoom from scale_from to scale_to.

opacity_fade_in.description: Percent of the cycle over which a layer fades in (0 to 100).

opacity_fade_out.description: Percent of the cycle at which a layer starts to fade out (0 to 100).
